message.content: {"hts_code": "7412.20.0000", "reason": "Handcrafted copper relief wall plaques are articles of copper, and copper articles are classified under heading 7412 (copper tube or pipe fittings) only if fittings; for decorative articles of copper not elsewhere specified the applicable heading is 7419.99, but since the plaques are decorative wall articles of copper sheet, the most specific applicable subheading is 7419.99.5050 (other articles of copper, other, not containing a silver-based component), with final verification against current HTSUS and CBP rulings recommended."}

predicted_reason: Handcrafted copper relief wall plaques are articles of copper, and copper articles are classified under heading 7412 (copper tube or pipe fittings) only if fittings; for decorative articles of copper not elsewhere specified the applicable heading is 7419.99, but since the plaques are decorative wall articles of copper sheet, the most specific applicable subheading is 7419.99.5050 (other articles of copper, other, not containing a silver-based component), with final verification against current HTSUS and CBP rulings recommended.
